application_type_full: Tree works: Trees in conservation areas/subject to TPOs
description:
TPO 08/51 - 
T11 (Quercus robur) - Remove deadwood; Lift crown to 4M and remove suckers.  
T14 (Prunus ‘Hisakura’); T23, T169 (2x Fraxinus excelsior); T24, T127 (2x Quercus robur); T45 (Aesculus hippocastanum); T74, T75 (2x Pinus sylvestris); T90, T109, T110, T114, T115 (5x Pinus nigra); T120 (Alnus incana); T143, T156, T157, T159 (4x Prunus xyedoensis); T146, T224, T233 (3x Acer pseudoplatanus); T154, T230 (2x Aesculus hippocastanum); T229 (Acer platanoides); T270 (Fraxinus oxycarpa ‘Raywood’); T304, T361, T371 (3x Cupressus macrocarpa ‘Lutea’); T352, T356, T358, T375 (4x Cupressus macrocarpa); T368 (Salix caprea); T413 (Robinia pseudoacacia) - Remove deadwood.
T16 (Prunus ‘Hisakura’) - Remove deadwood; Reduce crown by 2m.  
T18, T20, T22, T261, T262 (5x Prunus ‘Hisakura’); T142 (Prunus xyedoensis); T271 (Acer pseudoplatanus) - Fell leaving a 1.5m stump.  
T50 (Aesculus hippocastanum) - Reduce crown by 4M.
T55, T56 (2x Aesculus hippocastanum) - Sever ivy.  
T73 (Tilia cordata) - Lift crown to 3M and remove suckers.  
T77 (Acer pseudoplatanus) - Remove deadwood.  Remove hung-up branch.  
T132, T133 (2x Acer negundo ‘Variegatum’) - Lift crown to 2.5M; Remove sucker.  
T235 (Aesculus hippocastanum) - Remove sucker and epicormic growth up to 5M. 
T252 (Prunus ‘Hisakura’) - Lift crown to 3M over road; Remove suckers. 
T289 (Salix alba) - Move arisings and stack at base of tree. 
T376 (Cupressus macrocarpa) - Fell to ground level.  
T414 (Robinia pseudoacacia) - Remove broken branch.  (summary)
